# synthetic fixture mimicking npm-cache help (npm is Artistic-2.0;
# format reproduced by hand, no verbatim capture — see ../NOTICE.md)
Manipulates packages cache

Usage:
jym-npm cache add <package-spec>
jym-npm cache clean [<key>]
jym-npm cache ls [<name>@<version>]
jym-npm cache verify

Options:
[--cache <cache>]

Run "jym-npm help cache" for more info
